# Documentation Conventions

## Rules
- Layout: `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}/`. Outside `docs/` only root `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`
- User guides MUST live under `docs/guide/`. Internal monorepo docs (package internals, skills template rendering, low-level subsystem refs) MUST NOT live under `docs/guide/`; place in package ref dirs (`docs/skills/`, `docs/core/`, `docs/code-graph/`)
- Every `docs/guide/` doc: Docusaurus YAML frontmatter `title`, `description`, `sidebar_position` (integer). Compatible with `apps/public-web` static generation and `@specd/guide` build-time bundling
- `docs/guide/` config, workflow, schema, lifecycle guides MUST match `@specd/core` implementation and schemas:
  - `FsArchiveRepository` archive vars: `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`; no uninstalled template engines
  - Template substitution for hooks (`run:`, `instruction:`) and schema artifact templates (`template`, `instruction`, `deltaInstruction`, rules), including shell escaping for `run:`
  - Workspace config exhaustive: `metadataPath`, `graph` discovery, segment rules for `prefix`, reserved `'root'`
  - `specd project update`: orchestrates declared agent plugins; synthesizes `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, skill templates. Needed after manual `plugins.agents` edits or SpecD package upgrades. General config changes resolve at runtime without update
  - Code Graph as core capability in `code-graph.md`, `index.md`, `philosophy.md`, `skills.md`, `cli.md`: `--documents`, `--files`, `--spec <id>`, `--export <name> --from <surface>`, multi-file aggregated blast radius, traversal directions and depth, hotspot detection, implementation coverage diagnostics
- Opening page `docs/guide/what-is-specd.md`: first sidebar guide and public docs entry. What SpecD is and what a reader can do. Code Graph core (symbol and document search, blast radius, spec-to-code traceability). Links installation, quickstart, philosophy, guide index, `docs/guide/code-graph.md`. Guide index stays topic map and links to opening page
- `docs/guide/skills.md` MUST exist: skills as user↔CLI interface; slash command → agent steps → CLI; catalog `/specd`, `/specd-new`, `/specd-design`, `/specd-implement`, `/specd-verify`, `/specd-archive`, `/specd-compliance`, `/specd-fasttrack` (when to use); skills use `--format toon` and `specd guide`; skill files in `.agents/skills/`
- ADRs: MADR verbatim plus `### Spec` inside `## More Information` linking specs that capture derived constraints. Frontmatter: `status`, `date`, `decision-makers`, `consulted`, `informed`. Required: `## Context and Problem Statement`, `## Decision Outcome` with always-present `### Confirmation`. Optional (omit if no value): `## Decision Drivers`, `## Considered Options`, `## Pros and Cons of the Options`, `## More Information`. `### Spec` always present
- ADR numbers sequential from `0001`; filename `NNNN-kebab-title.md` (e.g. `0001-hexagonal-architecture.md`); never reuse; deprecated/superseded keep number, update status
- Create ADR for every significant decision: multi-package, constrains future development, or non-obvious choice between real alternatives. Implementation that follows naturally from prior ADRs needs no new ADR
- CLI: every `specd` command in `docs/cli/` (purpose, flags, examples, exit codes). MUST include `index.md` as command directory plus dedicated docs for all commands, including `guide.md` and lifecycle groups. Command-specific output, caching, or machine-consumed response behavior MUST be documented without reading implementation. Output-contract changes update matching `docs/cli/` doc in same change. User-facing CLI overviews, tutorials, recipes in `docs/guide/cli.md`
- MCP: every `@specd/mcp` tool and resource in `docs/mcp/` (input schema, output schema, example usage)
- `docs/core/`: `@specd/core` package reference — semantics, contracts, behaviour. NOT integrator import guide
- Integrators (hosts: cli, mcp, API, IPC) MUST import `@specd/sdk` only. MUST NOT mix `@specd/core` and `@specd/code-graph` imports for same host
- `docs/core/index.md` and `docs/code-graph/index.md` MUST include prominent callout: hosts start at `docs/sdk/` and import `@specd/sdk`
- `@specd/core` import examples MUST be labeled plugin / core-only, not hosts. Optional footnote MAY note re-export from `@specd/sdk`; MUST NOT read as integrators may choose either package. Core-only packages (`plugin-*`, `skills`) MAY use `@specd/core` as primary import in examples
- `docs/sdk/` examples MUST use `@specd/sdk` and document both assembly paths: `createKernel` + `kernel.*.execute()` and standalone `createX` / `create*Repository`
- `docs/sdk/` is only integrator Docusaurus entry (sidebar category **SDK**, before package-reference). MUST document: `@specd/sdk` single import surface for hosts — core, code-graph, SDK orchestration on `"."`, `"./ports"`, `"./extensions"`; hosts do not declare parallel `@specd/core` + `@specd/code-graph` dependencies or mix imports; host bootstrap (`openSpecdHost`, `createSdkContext`) and orchestration helpers; kernel-equivalent assembly via `createKernel` or standalone `createX` / `create*Repository` (all from `@specd/sdk`)
- Legacy `docs/core/sdk.md` MUST move into `docs/sdk/`. `docs/core/` and `docs/code-graph/` remain package-reference (sidebar **Package reference** or nested under SDK) for plugin authors and symbol semantics — not parallel integrator paths
- Website public API generation entry points and landing copy MUST treat `@specd/sdk` as integrator surface per `public-web:api-reference`
- JSDoc on ALL symbols (functions, methods, classes, type aliases, interfaces — not just public exports): description; `@param` each parameter; `@returns` (omit for `void` and constructors); `@throws` each error type
- Update `docs/` when `@specd/core` public composition surface changes. Factory contract changes MUST document: canonical `createX(deps)`; convenience `createX(config, options?)`; role split among standalone factories, `createKernel(...)`, `createKernelBuilder()`; shared `CompositionResolver` path for config-based bootstrap
- Removing/renaming a public template variable token (e.g. `{{change.workspace}}`), changing configuration cascade semantics, or changing listing/summary use case inputs, outputs, or dependency-resolution contract MUST update every in-repo `docs/` file that documents the old token, cascade rule, or shape, in the same change
- `docs/guide/configuration.md` and `docs/guide/configuration-examples.md` MUST stay consistent on layered cascade (`specd.yaml` + `specd.*.yaml` + `specd.local.yaml`)
- Applicable docs (illustrative, not exhaustive; any other file with same stale token or shape is in scope): `docs/guide/configuration.md`, `docs/guide/configuration-examples.md`, `docs/guide/installation.md`, `docs/guide/getting-started.md`, `docs/guide/workspaces.md`, `docs/guide/workflow.md`, `docs/guide/schemas.md`, `docs/schemas/schema-format.md`, `docs/adr/0013-workspaces-not-scopes.md`, `docs/core/use-cases.md`, `docs/cli/cli-reference.md`

## Constraints
- All docs Markdown
- ADR filename `NNNN-kebab-case-title.md`; numbers sequential, never reused
- Every significant architectural decision has an ADR
- Every ADR includes `### Spec` inside `## More Information` linking specs that capture its constraints
- Specs with associated ADRs include `## ADRs` (omit if none); lists only ADRs that produced that spec — historical provenance, not dependencies
- No documentation outside `docs/` except `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`
- Spec depends only on other specs (`## Spec Dependencies`), never on ADRs directly
- ADR decision enforced as constraint MUST first be captured in a spec; other specs depend on that spec
- Template token removal/rename or listing/summary public-contract change is documentation-affecting under `docs/config/`, `docs/guide/`, `docs/schemas/`, `docs/adr/`, `docs/core/`, and `docs/cli/` as applicable — not just `docs/core/`
